Draw paths as
Carets: one per position report (about once a minute), pointing the way the bike was heading as it arrived there. No connecting lines are drawn, so nothing cuts across blocks.
Path color
Speed mode colors every hop between two position reports (about a minute of riding) by its average speed, excluding time paused at a point. Hops are straight lines, so winding stretches read a little slow.
